mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 75 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School. Overnight, expect temperatures to drop to 71 degrees with rain in the forecast. Additionally, the International Space Station will be visible tonight at 8:17 PM for five minutes, rising from the South Southwest near Belleville and heading toward the East Northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The Verona Fire Department is inviting the community to an open house on September 19 from 10 AM until 2 PM at 101 Lincoln Street. It is a great chance to tour the station, meet local firefighters, and participate in fire safety activities with the whole family.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, you can head to the downtown Farmer's Market, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, grab a pizza and pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or test your brain at trivia nights hosted at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department recently released information regarding an arrest made on Friday, September 4. The investigation concerns an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred on Sunday, August 30, 2019.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
